evidence.inherited: 10 MW average IT and 8760-hour reference year from the frozen teaching baseline.
evidence.observed: Building identities and indicative map locations only; no measured heating demand or surveyed connection.
evidence.authored: All demand, schedule, temperature, recovery capacity, COP, equipment, route length and efficiency values below are selected teaching assumptions.
evidence.unknown: Actual heating systems, plant rooms, useful demand, routes, permissions, cooling credits, costs and net electricity/carbon effects remain unassessed.

units.route: m of assumed one-way route; supply and return required

model.scope: Occupied-weekday space heating only; no domestic hot water, storage, overnight/weekend demand or demand shifting. Both buildings use the same authored window; actual schedules are not inferred.
model.loss_method: Fixed end-to-end heat-delivery efficiencies per branch. They are explicit loss allowances, not a pipe-design calculation from the assumed lengths.
model.capacity_allocation: Cap each branch request by its hot-side capacity, then allocate the common hot-side budget proportionally to remaining requests. No priority optimisation.
